validation.backwardCompatibilityEvidence: the same 17 window documents stored by a long-running profile parse under 0.4.25 and 0.4.26, 12 fail under 0.4.27, and all 17 parse after this fix

review.independentReview: Owner-reported: after upgrading, the GUI showed state unknown for every session and the input-area summary disappeared. The window-document validator introduced with the 0.4.27 baseline field rejected every document written before it: the journal replay derives previousRuntimeId for each runtime replacement, and comparing that derived value against a stored document that never carried the field reported a state/history divergence. Measured on the owner's own store: 17 documents parse under 0.4.25 and 0.4.26, 12 fail under 0.4.27, all 17 parse after the fix. The comparison now follows the shape the document carries; a document that records the field is still compared in full so a wrong baseline stays invalid. Regression tests cover both directions.
